description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing customer data in a banking application. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers, using annotations for request mapping and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: A REST controller handling customer management endpoints such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customer records.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customer records.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Legacy GET endpoint for listing all customers for backward compatibility.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer's details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by customer number.
